Research options · live closed-source agent

Agent 1 and Agent 2 are the default comparison. Historical prompts and response formats differ; these are reviewer judgments, not a controlled performance ranking.

Agent 3 connects to an inference gateway. Provider API keys stay on the server. It does not load historical Agent 3 predictions.

Reason library

Jacob defaults are original expert vocabulary, not matched answers for the current case. New reviewer reasons are saved separately with their source.

CSV needs a text or reason column. One reason per line in text files. Existing reasons are retained; duplicates are skipped.

Restore feedback

Check a v3 export, then restore missing reviews to the current reviewer. Existing reviews and their history are preserved. Import the referenced dataset views first.

Reviewer identity

The lower-left Reviewer button selects your identity. To continue your review history on another computer, copy this reviewer key and use it there. This local SSH workspace has no account login.

Reviewer

Profiles keep review histories separate on this browser. A display name is not an account login. Export feedback JSON to transfer records.
